## About
Little Foreign Car Garage is a family owned shop on Thayer Road in Waltham. We handle repair, maintenance, race prep, restoration and used car sales, and we're an authorized Bosch Service Center.
We care about quality, and we want to get to know the people who bring us their cars. We've just renovated the shop inside and out, picked up some new scan tools and put in a whole new computer system. There's free WiFi if you need it while you're here.
If you're not one of our clients yet, give us a call and tell us how we can help. Skipper Hull and the rest of the LFCG family. Rated 4.5 on Google from 45 reviews.

## Services
- Manufacturers Scheduled Maintenance and Warrantees: Scheduled maintenance done to your manufacturer's plan.
- Carburetion and Fuel Injection: Fuel system work on older carbureted cars and newer fuel injected ones.
- High Performance: Racing and high performance work for cars that are headed to the track.
- Restoration: Classic automobile restoration done right here in our Waltham shop.
- Suspension: We'll go over your suspension and tell you which components need replacing.
- Used Car Sales: Along with repair work, we sell used cars. Ask us what's on the lot.
- Detailing: Our crew will detail your car inside and out. Call and ask for details.

## FAQ
Q: Do you offer financing?
A: Yes. Financing is available through the Bosch Credit Program. Call or email us to see how you can qualify.

Q: How do I book an appointment?
A: Pick a date and time that works for you, and tell us what your car needs. We'll do our best to fit you in, and we'll get in touch to confirm the final date and time.

Q: Is there WiFi while I wait?
A: Yes. We have free WiFi you can use while you're at the shop.

I love my 180k miles van which I have had for six years. Dennis went over them with me and quoted me a very fair price. It was no surprise to me that some investment was needed in the suspension and because I hope to get a few more years out of it I authorized the repairs. I could not believe the driving difference!

They are now my go-to shop. I find their advice extremely competent and they have never pressured me to make any repair recommendations. In short  . . . I trust them. They seem to want to give car owners great service that is truly needed at reasonable prices." (Jack Rutt, 5/5)
